title: Loops: preserve state and explain termination
goal: Trace accumulation, distinguish counter and accumulator, and independently write a finite loop with a new summation rule.

prerequisites.text: Complete Value types and Conditions: distinguish a number from a string and explain a test. Know how to open, save, and run a handler in your training infobase.

sections.title: Why the result must remember the previous iteration
paragraphs: You need the total duration of several equal intervals. Three intervals of15 minutes give45. A loop describes one action and a repetition rule, rather than merely hiding three repeated lines.

We will distinguish a counter from an accumulator, trace each transition, and check a case with no iterations. Then you will write a different program: add the current request number rather than a constant15.

sections.title: The counter and accumulator have different jobs
paragraphs: Номер identifies the current iteration. ВсегоМинут stores the sum of intervals already counted. ВсегоМинут = ВсегоМинут + 15 reads the previous total on the right, adds15, and stores the new value on the left.
Zero is assigned once before the loop: no intervals have been counted yet. After k iterations, ВсегоМинут should equal15×k. This relation explains the intermediate15 and30 as well as the final45.

sections.title: Complete example: three additions and one message
paragraphs: Для Номер = 1 По 3 assigns1, then2, then3 to the counter. The body between Цикл and КонецЦикла runs for each value. Сообщить follows КонецЦикла, so it displays the total once.
Read the table first and match it to the addition statement. One accumulator variable changes; you do not need three separate totals or three resets.

sections.title: Before revealing: only the upper bound changes
paragraphs: The next complete handler replaces По 3 with По 4. Add exactly one row to your trace, mentally or on paper. Keep15, the initial zero, and the location of Сообщить unchanged.
Predict both the total and the number of messages. Open the comparison after recording your own prediction.

reveal.title: Compare your prediction
paragraphs: The result is60: the fourth iteration takes45 and adds15. There is still one message; the statement after the loop has not become part of its body.

sections.title: A changed input checks the rule
paragraphs: For four iterations, the trace extends to0→15→30→45→60. The final result changes predictably because each iteration accounts for exactly one interval.
This is the same algorithm with a different bound, not the lesson's independent task. Keep this version separately to compare it with a new accumulation rule.

sections.title: An empty range: no iterations
paragraphs: For the range1..0, the Для body does not run. The initial ВсегоМинут remains0, and the message after the loop still runs. Zero does not become an extra iteration.
Draw only the initial state and exit for this case. An intermediate15 would be an invented step. A Пока whose initial test is false follows the same important idea: its body need not run even once.

sections.title: Valid syntax, but the previous sum is lost
paragraphs: The incorrect complete handler moves the reset into the body. Each addition first loses the previous result. Every iteration ends at15, so the final result is15 rather than45.

The first divergence occurs in the second iteration: the total should be15 before addition, but it has become0. You have found a specific lost transition; replacing the final line with a literal45 would hide the error.

sections.title: The message location changes what you observe
paragraphs: Moving Сообщить into the body displays intermediate15,30,45. Accumulation is unchanged, but the observable result is three messages rather than one final total.
Decide beforehand whether the task requires one final value or a trace. Merely including45 does not make the variants equivalent; message count and order are part of the requirement.

sections.title: Пока needs an explicit state change
paragraphs: Пока tests its condition before running the body. Unlike Для, it requires you to write the increment of Номер yourself. After the body, execution returns to the same test.

For a known integer N from0 to100, start with Номер=1 and increase it by1 each iteration. After finitely many iterations, Номер exceeds N and the test becomes false. Do not run the version without a counter change; fix its lack of termination first.

sections.title: The back edge returns to the test
paragraphs: In the diagram, N abbreviates КоличествоЗаявок. The test has two paths: true enters the body; false goes directly to the final message. After incrementing the counter, the arrow returns to the test, not to initialization.
Trace N=0 without entering the body. Then trace N=4: the final test sees Номер=5. That test ends the loop; successful compilation does not explain it by itself.

flow.caption: Пока: test before the body and return to the same test
alternative: N means КоличествоЗаявок. Before the first test, Номер=1 and Итог=0.
If Номер≤N, add the current number to the total, increase the number by1, and return to the test.
If the condition is false, skip the body, display the total once, and finish.
For N=0, the first test1≤0 is false: no additions, result0.
For N=4, after four additions Номер=5 and Итог=10; the test5≤4 is false.

sections.title: Now use a new rule: sum the current numbers
paragraphs: Write a finite Пока that adds1, then2,3,4 for four requests. The result is10. Adding a constant15 solves a different task and gives60; copying the worked example without changing its meaning is insufficient.

Also check5 requests →15,0 →0, and1 →1. Reset the accumulator before the loop and change the counter inside it. Practice provides a separate TODO starter, control cases, your own work window, and a reference on request.

sections.title: Продолжить skips the rest of one iteration
paragraphs: This separate finite example traverses1..5 but skips number3 before addition. The result is1+2+4+5=12. The loop continues with later values.

This flow-control comparison does not solve the independent task of summing all numbers. Later, Для Каждого will traverse collection elements; ordinary in-memory accumulation does not automatically read database documents.

sections.title: Прервать exits the entire loop
paragraphs: Replace Продолжить with Прервать at the same location. At number3, the loop exits before addition. Only1 and2 have been counted, so the total is3;4 and5 are not processed.

Explain the difference between skipping one number and stopping processing. Both programs are finite and can run in your own training infobase; an infinite loop is unnecessary for checking the distinction.

sections.title: Where the complete example belongs in 1C
paragraphs: Open your training infobase's application module from the configuration root. The screenshot shows the complete worked handler with three additions. Save any previous exercise separately first.
For your independent work, keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы and implement the new task inside it. Nexus can store a separate BSL draft; installed 1C executes it after saving and updating the infobase.

sections.title: What a matching result establishes
paragraphs: The separate training 1C checked the worked45, variations60 and0, incorrect reset15, independent totals10/15/0/1, and finite Прервать/Продолжить variants. The complete worked and independent handlers also produced45 and10 in the message window.

Matching these cases establishes observations for the exact sources and inputs. Check understanding through transition explanations and a changed case of your own; this experiment does not validate unknown input types or every possible program.

options: One0 message; the body did not run
selfcheck.feedback: The range1..0 is empty. The initial zero remains; the message after the loop runs once.

selfcheck.prompt: Where should a whole-loop accumulator be initialized?
options: At the end of each iteration
selfcheck.feedback: Resetting inside erases the preceding total.

selfcheck.prompt: What does the main example produce with По 4 instead of По 3?
How can the reset error be tested safely?
options: A separate finite copy with trace 15 → 0 → 15
selfcheck.feedback: Use an observable finite counterexample without damaging primary work.

selfcheck.prompt: In the new task, change only КоличествоЗаявок from4 to5. Which result and why?
selfcheck.feedback: After four iterations the total is10. The fifth adds5 to give15, a different rule from adding a constant15.

selfcheck.prompt: Explain one changed case in your own words: initial state, first important step, and difference from the worked example. What does the run establish, and what still needs an explanation?
selfcheck.feedback: This answer is not graded automatically. Check your explanation against the trace and keep your own prediction separate from actual messages.

practice.title: Your own sum of request numbers
practice.task: For a known integer КоличествоЗаявок from0 to100, write a finite Пока summing1…N. Require10 for4,15 for5,0 for0,1 for1. Display one final message. Explain what Итог preserves and why Номер changes.
practice.environment: Installed training 1C8.3, your separate infobase, and one application handler. Nexus stores separate work; 1C executes BSL.
practice.externalRoute: Own infobase → Designer → root → Открыть модуль приложения

paragraphs: You opened the reference on request. First compare initialization, addition of the current number, and counter changes with your version; viewing it does not replace your editor.

criteria: The four control inputs produce10,15,0,1; one message is displayed after the loop.
The accumulator is initialized once before the loop; the current number is added.
Each iteration changes the counter; the exit condition is explained. N=0 does not invent an iteration.
Your prediction, actual messages, and explanation of the first divergence in an incorrect version are recorded.
practice.hint: Trace Итог and Номер separately. Under the new rule, the total after two iterations is3 rather than30.

steps.title: Make your own prediction first
steps.where: Nexus → Practice → your separate draft and run note
steps.action: Before running, record a trace for4 and a separate path for0. Label Итог and Номер before every test.
steps.why: A prediction records the dependency you expect before you compare it with a fact.
steps.expected: Your expectations are recorded separately from the actual result.

steps.title: Open the correct location
steps.where: Own training infobase → Designer → configuration root → Открыть модуль приложения
steps.action: Save the previous training source separately. Open your own infobase's application module and keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler.
steps.why: Work must run in a known training infobase, with a saved copy of the previous source.
steps.expected: The correct module is open; the previous version is saved.

steps.title: Implement your own version
steps.action: Start with the TODO starter and complete it yourself. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your saved Nexus code.
steps.why: The independent program uses a new rule; the worked example does not solve it.
steps.expected: A complete independent handler has clear variables and one entry point.

steps.title: Check it in installed 1C
steps.action: Save the module, update the database configuration, and start your own client. Record actual messages for each control input and compare them with your prediction.
steps.why: Installed 1C executes BSL; Nexus stores a learning draft and a result note.
steps.expected: Each case has an exact input and an observed actual output.

steps.title: Record the result
steps.where: Result recording → your BSL file and Nexus → external-run note
steps.action: Save the source, a prediction/fact/explanation table, and one changed case of your own. If results differ, find the first diverging step.
steps.why: The same final line does not establish correctness of every step or understanding.
steps.expected: Code, facts, and your own explanation remain separately available; completion is a self-report.
